newsitem.title: BOTSWANA: BOTSWANA STOCKS WEEK-DOMESTIC INDEX AT RECORD HIGH.
newsitem.headline: BOTSWANA STOCKS WEEK-DOMESTIC INDEX AT RECORD HIGH.

text.p: The Botswana Stock Exchange's (BSE) domestic index rose to a record high of 386.66 in the week ending March 14 from 384.76 the week before.
Volume and value were well up with 5,596,464 shares worth 15.21 million pula changing hands compared with the 3,271,475 shares worth 3.27 million pula traded in the previous week.

Standard Chartered Bank Botswana increased its price by five thebe to reach an all-time high of 515, while Botswana's brewery holding company Sechaba Investment Co attracted strong foreign interest and traded 5,557,400 shares.
Botswana Insurance shares rose five thebe to 215.
Last week marked the first trades in dual listed stocks on the BSE which saw De Beers trade 4,500 shares and Regent Undervalued Assets Africa Fund trade 150 shares.

All stocks traded except security group Inco , milling company and food wholesaler Sefalana Holdings Co. and variable loan stock Real Estate Development Company Properties Ltd . Oil company Engen was bid up to 4,490 thebe, but there were no sellers.
On the foreign board 4,750 shares were traded.
The foreign index closed at 391.10 from 384.76 previously and the All Companies Index settled at 391.96 from 384.76.
